description: Meet Fonio (pronounced phone-yo): West Africa's oldest grain. This tiny ancient grain holds a place of honor in cultures and cuisines across West Africa and has been grown by smallholder farmers for thousands of years. To the Dogon people of Mali, it is “The Seed of the Universe,” the grain at the root of all existence. Fonio grows across the Sahel region: the semi-arid band between the Sahara desert and lush forests to the south. The Sahel region’s hot, dry climate and poor sandy soil do not support most crops. But fonio flourishes. Its extensive roots help it draw water from deep underground and secure the topsoil from erosion, making it a climate smart grain. More than half of the world’s food energy comes from three “mega-crops”: rice, wheat, and corn. Including different grains like fonio into your diet helps to increase our planet's biodiversity and resilience. Yassa! Fonio Pilaf, aka The Spice: "Yassa chicken, a delicious dish of caramelized onion, lime, and chicken, is one of Sengal's most famous dishes," Yolélé co-founder Chef Pierre Thiam explains in his seminal cookbook "Senegal: Modern Senegalese Recipes from the Source to the Bowl." Inspired by that dish, this pilaf is a perfect introduction to Senegalese cuisine. The flavors are complex and deep. Yassa Fonio Pilaf offers sweetness from caramelized onion, combined with the smokiness of roasted peppers, and acidity of lime to create all the comforting traditional yassa flavors in one easy to make side dish.

description: Meet Fonio (pronounced phone-yo): West Africa's oldest grain. This tiny ancient grain holds a place of honor in cultures and cuisines across West Africa. Fonio has been grown by smallholder farmers for thousands of years. In Africa it's served to guests of honor, placed as a good luck token in kid's backpacks. To the Dogon people of Mali, it is “The Seed of the Universe,”the grain at the root of all existence. Yolélé co-founder Chef Pierre Thiam explains, in The Fonio Cookbook, that, “we consider eating together, around a communal bowl, as a sign of love and trust for the people sitting around the bowl. Whenever fonio is served, it’s another sign of honoring the guest, as fonio is also nicknamed “ñamu buur,” or “food for royalty.” Fonio is also a good luck charm, and moms are known to put some fonio in children’s backpacks before sending them off to school, especially during exam season. Fonio has even been found entombed in Ancient Egyptian pyramids, so valued that people believed it should be brought with them to the afterlife. Drought-resistant, with deep roots that prevent erosion and preserve topsoil, fonio is also ready to harvest in as little as 60 days. It really is a miracle crop. Fonio grows across the Sahel, the semi-arid band between the Sahara desert and lush forests to the south. The region’s hot, dry climate and poor sandy soil do not support most crops. But fonio flourishes in that setting. Its extensive roots help it draw water from deep underground and secure the topsoil from erosion, making it a climate smart grain. More than half of the world’s food energy comes from three “mega-crops”: rice, wheat, and corn. Including different grains like fonio into your diet helps to increase our planet's biodiversity and resilience.

description: Meet Fonio (pronounced phone-yo): West Africa's oldest grain. This tiny ancient grain holds a place of honor in cultures and cuisines across West Africa and has been grown by smallholder farmers for thousands of years. To the Dogon people of Mali, it is “The Seed of the Universe,” the grain at the root of all existence. Fonio grows across the Sahel region: the semi-arid band between the Sahara desert and lush forests to the south. The Sahel region’s hot, dry climate and poor sandy soil do not support most crops. But fonio flourishes. Its extensive roots help it draw water from deep underground and secure the topsoil from erosion, making it a climate smart grain. More than half of the world’s food energy comes from three “mega-crops”: rice, wheat, and corn. Including different grains like fonio into your diet helps to increase our planet's biodiversity and resilience. Dakar Curry Fonio Pilaf, aka The Market: You may not think that you'd find Curry in West Africa, but these ingredients have made their way across the globe, and the capital city of Senegal is no exception. In his cookbook, "Senegal," our co-founder chef Pierre Thiam explains, "the city is a melting pot where cultures from all over the world have met." Our mild, warming curry evokes the scents and flavors of walking through an open air market in Dakar-- and so many other vibrant cities of the world.

description: Meet Fonio (pronounced phone-yo): West Africa's oldest grain. This tiny ancient grain holds a place of honor in cultures and cuisines across West Africa and has been grown by smallholder farmers for thousands of years. To the Dogon people of Mali, it is “The Seed of the Universe,” the grain at the root of all existence. Fonio grows across the Sahel region: the semi-arid band between the Sahara desert and lush forests to the south. The Sahel region’s hot, dry climate and poor sandy soil do not support most crops. But fonio flourishes. Its extensive roots help it draw water from deep underground and secure the topsoil from erosion, making it a climate smart grain. More than half of the world’s food energy comes from three “mega-crops”: rice, wheat, and corn. Including different grains like fonio into your diet helps to increase our planet's biodiversity and resilience. Jollof Fonio Pilaf, aka The Party.

Rich, creamy risotto is one of Northern Italy's gastronomic delights. The key ingredient in authentic risotto is the short, thick grained rice known as Arborio. This rice is the perfect grain for risotto because its texture and cooking properties allow it to retain firmness throughout preparation. Risotto should always be prepared al dente which means tender yet firm to the bite. Alessi Risotto con Funghi Porcini offers a most unique blend of flavor. title: Zatarain's Spanish Rice, 6.9 oz

description:
Zatarain's Spanish Rice, a New Orleans tradition since 1889, is a flavorful gluten-free side dish bringing the authentic flavor and soul of New Orleans to your table in under 30 minutes. Your family will be begging for more when you serve this savory blend of soulful aromas and flavors. More than 1,500 years ago, North African immigrants brought rice to Spain, where the crop thrived. It wasn’t long before Spanish cooks were simmering rice with onions, bell pepper, garlic and tomatoes to create what is known in the U.S. as Spanish rice. Spanish rice is popular for its flavor and versatility. Simply add fresh tomatoes to Zatarain’s Spanish Rice and serve alongside steak, chicken or any Latin American-inspired entrée.

El Arroz Español de Zatarain, una tradición de Nueva Orleans desde 1889, es un sabroso plato sin gluten que trae el auténtico sabor y el alma de Nueva Orleans a tu mesa en menos de 30 minutos. Su familia le rogará más cuando sirva esta sabrosa mezcla de aromas y sabores conmovedores. Hace más de 1.500 años, los inmigrantes norteafricanos trajeron arroz a España, donde prosperó la cosecha. No pasó mucho tiempo antes de que los cocineros españoles estuvieran a fuego lento arroz con cebolla, pimiento, ajo y tomates para crear lo que se conoce en Estados Unidos como arroz español. El arroz español es popular por su sabor y versatilidad. Simplemente agregue tomates frescos al arroz español de Zatarain y sirva junto con carne, pollo o cualquier plato de inspiración latinoamericana.

Zatarains spanischer Reis, eine New Orleans Tradition seit 1889, ist eine geschmackvolle, glutenfreie Beilage, die den authentischen Geschmack und die Seele von New Orleans in weniger als 30 Minuten auf Ihren Tisch bringt. الأرز الإسباني من زاتارين، وهو تقليد نيو أورليانز منذ عام 1889، هو طبق جانبي لذيذ خالٍ من الغلوتين يجلب النكهة والروح الأصلية لنيو أورليانز إلى طاولتك في أقل من 30 دقيقة. ستتوسل عائلتك للحصول على المزيد عندما تقدم هذا المزيج اللذيذ من الروائح والنكهات الحانية. منذ أكثر من 1500 عام، جلب مهاجرون شمال أفريقيا الأرز إلى إسبانيا، حيث ازدهر المحاصيل. لم يكن ذلك قبل أن يقوم الطهاة الإسبانية بغمر الأرز بالبصل والفلفل الجرس والثوم والطماطم لخلق ما يُعرف في الولايات المتحدة باسم الأرز الإسباني. الأرز الإسباني مشهور بنكهته وتنوع استخداماته. ببساطة أضف الطماطم الطازجة إلى أرز زاتارين الإسباني وقدمها إلى جانب شريحة اللحم أو الدجاج أو أي مدخل مستوحى من أمريكا اللاتينية.

description:
Conchita Spanish Style Yellow Rice 

Completely seasoned yellow rice following the authentic Spanish recipe, and it's easy to prepare. 

Flavored with onion and garlic, either as a side dish, or as the beginning of your own Paella, Conchita Yellow Rice makes every meal a special occasion. 

 


Cooking Directions - On the Stove 

Bring 2 cups of water and 1 tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil to a boil in a medium saucepan. 
Stir in 1 Cup of Conchita Spanish Yellow Rice. 
Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. 
Fluff lightly with fork and serve. 

Famed for its vivid yellow hue and savory flavor, Conchita Spanish Style Yellow Rice is a tasty dish that pairs well with any meal. 

 


Cooking Directions - Microwave 

In a microwave safe dish, combine 2 cups hot water, 1 tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil and 1 Cup Conchita Spanish Yellow Rice. 
Cover and microwave on HIGH for 3 minutes. 
Reduce setting to 50% power and microwave for 17 minutes. 
Fluff lightly with fork and serve. 
If your microwave does not have variable power settings, follow your manufacturer's directions.

description:
Paellero seasoning brings brings the authentic spices of Spain to your paella, including real saffron. Each box contains three packets of seasonings, and each packet is enough for a paella that serves four people. Simply add the contents of the envelope to your favorite recipe for a paella to remember! 

The chefs at Carmencita have honed this paella spice mix for more than 25 years, cooking literally hundreds of paellas until the balance of flavors was perfect. Paellero is 100% natural with no coloring agents and with extra proportion of real saffron. 

Carmencita began in 1920 when Jesús Navarro Jover began offering packets of saffron for sale in a town near Alicante, in the heart of paella country. What began as a one man small business has grown over the last century into one of the most reputable spice companies in all of Spain. 

Here is the recipe: 


Simple Paella by Carmencita: 

Heat the paella pan with olive oil. Fry up a head of garlic (optional) and some red pepper strips. Set the pepper strips aside. Fry up the chicken pieces until they are well browned. Add 5 1/2 cups of water and the packet of paellero Carmencita. Taste for salt When it comes to a boil, add the 14 oz of rice. Halfway through the cooking process, decorate the paella with the red pepper strips. Cook on high heat until the rice has absorbed the stock. Take off the heat and wait a few minutes before serving 

Ingredients: 
4 oz of olive oil 
1 head of garlic, unpeeled (optional) 
1 red bell pepper, sliced 
3/4 lb chicken pieces 
1 3/4 cups of paella rice 
1 packet of Paellero Carmencita 
5 1/2 cups of water

title: Alessi - Risotto with Sun Dried Tomatoes
bullet_point: [Product of Italy, Italian Arborio Rice with Italian Sun-Dried Tomatoes, Traditional Northern Italian Dish, Excellent Served with Grilled Meats, (2)- 8 oz. Pkgs. -- 4 Servings per Package]
description:
Italy is Europe's largest producer of rice. The wetlands and cool temperatures of the Lombardi region harbor the ideal conditions for lush rice fields. Resourceful Italians combined rice with the many other items common to their area and developed a dish they lay claim to. It is known as risotto. Rich, creamy risotto is one of Northern Italy's gastronomic delights. The key ingredient in authentic risotto is the short, thick grained rice known as Arborio. This rice is the perfect grain for risotto because its texture and cooking properties allow it to retain firmness throughout preparation. Risotto should always be prepared al dente which means tender yet firm to the bite. 

Alessi Risotto Con Pomodori Secchi is an easy to prepare culinary treat. The sun dried tomatoes used in this product are from the farmlands of sunny Italy. Handpicked while juicy, red and fragrantly ripe they are then split in half, salted and laid out on a large wooden flat to dry in the sun. This has been a traditional yet popular dish throughout Northern Italy. This dish is a wonderful accompaniment to most grilled meats, especially chicken.

عالج براعم التذوق الخاصة بك مع كنور رايس ميدلي (158.8 جم). يجمع مزيج الأرز والمعكرونة لدينا بخبرة بين الأرز والمعكرونة والبازلاء والجزر للحصول على طبق لذيذ. جوانب الأرز المتبلة اللذيذة رائعة كجزء من طبق رئيسي لذيذ أو طبق جانبي مستقل. اجعل جوانب كنور رايس أساس عشاء لطيف الحشود. من المؤكد أن عائلتك سوف تحب النكهة اللذيذة لميدل الأرز من كنور (158.8 جم). بالإضافة إلى المذاق اللذيذ، فإن مجموعة الأرز ميدلي الخاصة بنا سريعة وسهلة التجهيز. يمكن طهي جوانب الأرز من كنور في سبعة دقائق فقط على الموقد أو الميكروويف. لا تحتوي جوانب الأرز من كنور على نكهات صناعية مما يجعلها خيارًا ممتازًا لإعداد وجبة مفضلة للعائلة. استخدم جوانب كنور لصنع طبق رئيسي يسيل اللعاب ببساطة قم بتحضير جوانب أرز كنور وأضف اللحم والخضروات المفضلة لديك لإعداد عشاء ستحبها عائلتك بالتأكيد. يمكنك العثور على وصفات رائعة من كنور مثل مدلي الدجاج والأرز المستوحى من الطهاة -- ببساطة أضف الدجاج والبصل والفطر. اكتشف المزيد من أفكار العشاء السريعة واللذيذة على Knorr.com. هناك مئات الوصفات لمساعدتك في العثور على إلهام العشاء. تحتوي كنور أيضًا على جوانب معكرونة وجوانب فيستا وجوانب إيطالية وأكثر من ذلك. تقدم كنور أكثر من 40 نوعًا من جوانب الأرز والمعكرونة حتى تتمكن من التأكد من العثور على النكهات التي ستحبها عائلتك. تؤمن كنور بأن الطعام الجيد مهم ووجبات الطعام اليومية يمكن أن تكون سحرية مثل المناسبات الخاصة. منتجات كنور تدين بمذاقها ونكهاتها لمهارات الطبخ وشغف الطهاة. مصدر كنور مكونات عالية الجودة لصنع أطباق جانبية لذيذة وعبوات وصلصات ومرق وحساء وتوابل تستمتع بها العائلات في كل مكان.

description: Italy is Europe's largest producer of rice. The wetlands and cool temperatures of the Lombardi region harbor the ideal conditions for lush rice fields. Resourceful Italians combined rice with the many other items common to their area and developed a dish they lay claim to. It is known as risotto. Rich, creamy risotto is one of Northern Italy's gastronomic delights. The key ingredient in authentic risotto is the short, thick grained rice known as Arborio. This rice is the perfect grain for risotto because its texture and cooking properties allow it to retain firmness throughout preparation. Risotto should always be prepared al dente which means tender yet firm to the bite. Alessi Risotto con Funghi Porcini offers a most unique blend of flavor. Funghi Porcini are a particular type of mushroom found throughout the woodlands of Italy beneath pine trees. They are known for their woodsy, aromatic scent and are a wonderful addition to this Italian favorite. This dish is a wonderful accompaniment to most grilled meats, especially lamb.

האורז הספרדי של Zatarain, מסורת ניו אורלינס מאז 1889, היא מנה צדדית נטולת גלוטן המביאה את הטעם האותנטי והנשמה של ניו אורלינס לשולחן שלך תוך פחות מ-30 דקות. המשפחה שלך תתחנן לעוד כאשר תשרת את התערובת המלוחה הזו של ניחוחות וטעמים נשמים. לפני יותר מ-1,500 שנה, מהגרים הצפון אפריקאים הביאו אורז לספרד, שם היבול שגשג. לא היה זמן רב לפני שהטבחים הספרדיים בישלו אורז עם בצל, פלפל, שום ועגבניות כדי ליצור את מה שידוע בארה"ב כאורז ספרדי. אורז ספרדי פופולרי בזכות הטעם והרב-תכליתיות שלו. פשוט הוסיפו עגבניות טריות לאורז הספרדי של Zatarain והגישו לצד סטייק, עוף או כל כניסה בהשראה אמריקאית לטינית.

الأرز الإسباني من زاتارين، وهو تقليد نيو أورليانز منذ عام 1889، هو طبق جانبي لذيذ خالٍ من الغلوتين يجلب النكهة والروح الأصلية لنيو أورليانز إلى طاولتك في أقل من 30 دقيقة. ستتوسل عائلتك للحصول على المزيد عندما تقدم هذا المزيج اللذيذ من الروائح والنكهات الحانية. منذ أكثر من 1500 عام، جلب مهاجرون شمال أفريقيا الأرز إلى إسبانيا، حيث ازدهر المحاصيل. لم يكن ذلك قبل أن يقوم الطهاة الإسبانية بغمر الأرز بالبصل والفلفل الجرس والثوم والطماطم لخلق ما يُعرف في الولايات المتحدة باسم الأرز الإسباني. الأرز الإسباني مشهور بنكهته وتنوع استخداماته. ببساطة أضف الطماطم الطازجة إلى أرز زاتارين الإسباني وقدمها إلى جانب شريحة اللحم أو الدجاج أو أي مدخل مستوحى من أمريكا اللاتينية.

O arroz espanhol da Zatarain, uma tradição de Nova Orleans desde 1889, é um saboroso prato sem glúten, levando o sabor e a alma autênticos de Nova Orleães para sua mesa em menos de 30 minutos. Sua família vai implorar por mais quando você servir esta mistura saborosa de aromas e sabores com alma. Há mais de 1.500 anos, os imigrantes norte da África trouxeram arroz para a Espanha, onde a cultivo prosperou. Não demorou muito antes que cozinheiros espanhóis estivessem ferver arroz com cebolas, pimentão, alho e tomates para criar o que é conhecido nos EUA como arroz espanhol. O arroz espanhol é popular por seu sabor e versatilidade. Basta adicionar tomates frescos ao arroz espanhol de Zatarain e servir junto com bifes, frango ou qualquer entrada inspirada na América Latina.

1889년 이래 뉴올리언스의 전통인 자타레인의 스페인 쌀은 30분 이내에 뉴 올리언스의 정통 맛과 영혼을 테이블에 가져다 주는 맛의 글루텐 프리 반찬입니다. 이 풍미 있는 향기와 풍미의 조화를 제공하면 가족들이 더 많은 것을 구걸 것입니다. 1,500년 전, 북아프리카 이민자들은 농작물이 번창한 스페인에 쌀을 가져왔습니다. 스페인 요리사가 미국에서 스페인어 쌀로 알려진 것을 만들기 위해 양파, 피망, 마늘, 토마토로 쌀을 끓이기 전에는 그리 멀지 않았습니다. 스페인 쌀은 맛과 다재다능함으로 유명합니다. 자타레인의 스페인산 쌀에 신선한 토마토를 넣고 스테이크, 닭고기 또는 라틴 아메리카에서 영감을 얻은 앙트레와 함께 제공하십시오.

description: Meet Fonio (pronounced phone-yo): West Africa's oldest grain. This tiny ancient grain holds a place of honor in cultures and cuisines across West Africa and has been grown by smallholder farmers for thousands of years. To the Dogon people of Mali, it is “The Seed of the Universe,” the grain at the root of all existence. Fonio grows across the Sahel region: the semi-arid band between the Sahara desert and lush forests to the south. The Sahel region’s hot, dry climate and poor sandy soil do not support most crops. But fonio flourishes. Its extensive roots help it draw water from deep underground and secure the topsoil from erosion, making it a climate smart grain. More than half of the world’s food energy comes from three “mega-crops”: rice, wheat, and corn. Including different grains like fonio into your diet helps to increase our planet's biodiversity and resilience. Greens! Fonio Pilaf, aka The Garden: The hero of our Greens! is moringa. In his cookbook, "Senegal," our co-founder chef Pierre Thiam explains that " Moringa is so highly nutritious that the tree's nicknames are "miracle tree" and nevedaye, as in "never die." Indeed, moringa, whose tiny leaves taste like spinach, is jam packed with Vitamins A and C, protein, calcium, fiber, beta-carotene, and iron. The leaves can be eaten raw, sauteed, or cooked in any number of stews, soups, and dishes such as mboum, a traditional millet couscous stew."
